segments.name: IT Services
segments.description: Provides AI-powered technology services and consulting to clients worldwide, organized by strategic market units and global business lines.
segments.evidence: The IT Services segment primarily consists of IT services offerings to customers organized by four Strategic Market Units (" SMUs ") - Americas 1, Americas 2, Europe and Asia Pacific Middle East and Africa (" APMEA ").

segments.name: IT Products
products: software products such as databases and operating systems
segments.description: Resells third-party hardware and software products to clients, complementing the company's IT services offerings.
segments.evidence: Our IT Products segment provides a range of third-party IT products including computing platforms and storage, networking solutions, enterprise information security, and software products such as databases and operating systems.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay for IT services and consulting engagements, and for third-party hardware and software products resold through the IT Products segment.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company is a value-added reseller of security, packaged and SaaS software for leading international brands.
